allocation.rule: for each pair p: h = sha256(seed + '|' + p); if (h[0] & 1) == 0 then variant x runs under A and y under B, else y under A and x under B

budgets.tool_call_definition: one hook-covered local operation admitted by the synchronous Codex PreToolUse hook; Bash shell launches count once including terminal transport continuations, apply_patch and other explicitly smoked local invocations count individually; shell subcommands and code-mode wrappers add no slots beyond intercepted nested operations; distinct retry IDs count separately; no hosted tools, subagents, external provider sessions or unsmoked specialized paths
budgets.provider_usage_budget: not capped by the pilot; logged separately when native usage records exist
budgets.no_selective_extension: bounds are never extended after an outcome is seen; a trial that reaches a bound is stopped and recorded as such
budgets.attempts_and_denials: every submitted invocation is logged as attempted; denied ones are logged separately with the reason and never counted as admitted or dropped

count_hook.settings_delivery: invocation-local -c inline hooks, features.hooks=true, agents.enabled=false, web_search=disabled; exact argv and allowed tool surface frozen; no global configuration/auth edits
count_hook.exact_hook_frozen: hook script, library, config template and installed binary sha256 frozen with linked sanitized installed-runtime smoke evidence
count_hook.counter: one locked append-only event log per trial; registered original/replacement session IDs share the base-role counter; retired or unknown sessions are denied
count_hook.records: hook event, session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, tool name, role, category, admitted/denied reason and time; never raw inputs
count_hook.deny_after: 40 admitted operations, wall deadline, trial closure or context retirement
count_hook.must_be_smoke_tested: lead-owned exact installed interactive CLI smoke demonstrating coverage, IDs, parallel 39/40/41, zero-effect denial, retirement/replacement, deadline, malformed input and missing-state/failure behavior
count_hook.failure_rule: missing/unsmoked coverage, identity, count-source mismatch, malformed state, hook failure/timeout or uncovered state-changing use makes the trial harness_invalid; hooks cannot prove a universal native-call cap
count_hook.lock_rule: mkdir lock is never stolen based on age; abandoned locks cause denial and require lead-owned harness invalidation/cleanup, with evidence retained

budgets.wall_includes: replacement startup and claim-expiry waits are inside the same 12-minute wall budget
budgets.no_pause_or_extension: the clock is never paused, moved or extended to help a slow arm
budgets.deadline_state: at the deadline the harness blocks new calls, stops only run-owned activity and captures the state; work completing after the deadline does not enter the scored artifact
budgets.unit: hook-covered local operations, deliberately amended before observation; not all native tool invocations
budgets.transport_reporting: write_stdin polls/continuations and available full runtime-call totals are reported separately from admitted operations; unavailable without complete run-owned runtime records

timeline_ms_from_t0.t0: the packet barrier: trial.started is recorded once both packets are delivered; all offsets use this one monotonic trial clock
timeline_ms_from_t0.overlap_opportunity: exists from t0 by construction: both items need the same new shared helper
